parameters.content:
## 1 · Intake
Two doors in: the **n8n form** and the **website webhook** (`POST /halden-lead`, JSON or text/plain).

**Settings & normalize** holds the only settings (L0 ID, emails) and turns both input shapes into one lead object.

Webhook answers instantly; work continues after.

## 2 · Rules (L0)
L0 validates and scores the lead with fixed rules (0–100, hot/warm/cold).

Rejected leads (no name, no valid contact, honeypot spam) go to the **Rejects** tab and stop here.

## 3 · Exact-repeat guard
Looks up the submission's idempotency key in the **Events** tab.
Seen before → stop (no 2nd contact, no 2nd email).
New → claim it in Events first.

Safe because this n8n runs one production execution at a time.

## 4 · Save + instant reply (no AI wait)
Saves the **rules score** to HubSpot (upsert on unique `lead_key`), then emails **new contacts with an email** within seconds.
Returning contacts and phone-only leads get no email.

Seconds from submit → reply is saved as `first_reply_seconds`.

## 5 · AI note (optional layer)
Groq **gpt-oss-20b** reads only city + message and suggests `adjust` (±10) + a one-line summary.

If Groq fails, this node outputs an error item, `adjust` becomes 0 and the lead still flows.
L0 clamps the adjust in code. The AI can never set tier or status.

## 6 · Final save + hot alert
Saves final score, tier and AI summary to the same contact.
If the final tier is **hot**, the team gets an alert with phone, reasons and a HubSpot link.
